## Overview

A small status/count label, or a bare notification dot.

## Properties

| Property  | Attribute | Description                                                 | Type                                                                                   | Default     |
| --------- | --------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------- |
| `color`   | `color`   | Semantic color of the badge.                                | `"error" \| "info" \| "neutral" \| "primary" \| "secondary" \| "success" \| "warning"` | `'primary'` |
| `dot`     | `dot`     | Renders as a small notification dot instead of a text pill. | `boolean`                                                                              | `false`     |
| `size`    | `size`    | Size of the badge.                                          | `"md" \| "sm" \| "xs"`                                                                 | `'sm'`      |
| `variant` | `variant` | Visual style of the badge.                                  | `"outline" \| "soft" \| "solid"`                                                       | `'solid'`   |
